   Direct frozen dependencies: none; all imported mathematical declarations are pinned Mathlib.
   The projection condition is inlined literally in claim; its private instance proof uses
   the pinned Mathlib IsStarProjection owner through the real-matrix correspondence.
   Private theorem proof_shape and consumers:
     instance_is_projection: bind-only; consumer: result
     sixPerms_univ: bind-only; consumer=sym_form
     v_dot_v: bind-only; consumer=word_product
     v_dot_z: bind-only; consumer=word_form
     word_product: bind-only; consumer=word_form

     mean_mul_z: bind-only; consumer=mean_form
     mean_form: bind-only; consumer=quadratic_form_value

import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.PosDef
import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.StarProjection

open Matrix
open scoped BigOperators

namespace D5.S3.Quantum.Matrix.ProjectionAMGMRefutation

noncomputable section

def meanProj {n N : ℕ} (P : Fin n → Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ) :=
  ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) • ∑ i, P i

def symProd {n N : ℕ} (P : Fin n → Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ) :=
  ((n.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹) • ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n),
    (List.ofFn (fun k => P (σ k))).reverse.prod

def claim : Prop :=
  ∀ (n N : ℕ) (P : Fin n → Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ),
    1 ≤ n → (∀ i, (P i)ᵀ = P i ∧ P i * P i = P i) →
      (meanProj P ^ n - symProd P).PosSemidef

private def z : Fin 3 → ℝ := fun _ => 1

private def v (i : Fin 3) : Fin 3 → ℝ := fun j => 2 * (if j.val = i.val then 1 else 0) - z j

private def P (i : Fin 3) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  (1 / 3 : ℝ) • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)

private theorem instance_is_projection (i : Fin 3) :
    (P i)ᵀ = P i ∧ P i * P i = P i := by
  have h : IsStarProjection (P i) := by
    rw [isStarProjection_iff', Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
    fin_cases i <;> constructor
    all_goals
      ext a b
      fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;>
        norm_num [P, v, z, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.mul_apply,
          Matrix.vecMulVec, Matrix.smul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  rw [isStarProjection_iff', Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at h
  exact h.symm

private def sixPerms : Finset (Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :=
  {1, Equiv.swap 0 1, Equiv.swap 0 2, Equiv.swap 1 2,
    Equiv.swap 0 1 * Equiv.swap 1 2, Equiv.swap 1 2 * Equiv.swap 0 1}

private theorem sixPerms_univ : sixPerms = Finset.univ := by
  apply Finset.eq_univ_of_card
  rw [Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_fin]
  decide +kernel

private theorem v_dot_v (a b : Fin 3) (h : a ≠ b) : v a ⬝ᵥ v b = -1 := by
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;>
    first | exact (h rfl).elim | norm_num [v, z, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

private theorem v_dot_z (a : Fin 3) : v a ⬝ᵥ z = -1 := by
  fin_cases a <;> norm_num [v, z, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

private theorem word_product (a b c : Fin 3) (hab : a ≠ b) (hbc : b ≠ c) :
    P a * P b * P c = (1 / 27 : ℝ) • Matrix.vecMulVec (v a) (v c) := by
  simp only [P, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_smul, smul_smul]
  rw [v_dot_v a b hab, v_dot_v b c hbc]
  norm_num

private theorem word_form (a b c : Fin 3) (hab : a ≠ b) (hbc : b ≠ c) :
    z ⬝ᵥ ((P a * P b * P c) *ᵥ z) = 1 / 27 := by
  rw [word_product a b c hab hbc, Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul,
    dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_vecMulVec, smul_dotProduct,
    dotProduct_comm z (v a), v_dot_z a, v_dot_z c]
  norm_num

private theorem mean_mul_z : meanProj P *ᵥ z = (1 / 9 : ℝ) • z := by
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    norm_num [meanProj, P, v, z, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.vecMulVec,
      Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

private theorem mean_form : z ⬝ᵥ ((meanProj P ^ 3) *ᵥ z) = 1 / 243 := by
  simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
    Matrix.mulVec_smul, mean_mul_z, smul_smul, dotProduct_smul]
  norm_num [dotProduct, z, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

private theorem sym_form : z ⬝ᵥ (symProd P *ᵥ z) = 1 / 27 := by
  have hword (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
      z ⬝ᵥ ((List.ofFn (fun k => P (σ k))).reverse.prod *ᵥ z) = 1 / 27 := by
    simp only [List.ofFn_succ, List.ofFn_zero, List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_nil,
      List.nil_append, List.cons_append, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    apply word_form
    · exact σ.injective.ne (by decide)
    · exact σ.injective.ne (by decide)
  unfold symProd
  rw [← sixPerms_univ, Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul,
    Matrix.sum_mulVec, dotProduct_sum]
  simp only [hword, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hcard : sixPerms.card = 6 := by decide +kernel
  rw [hcard]
  norm_num [Nat.factorial]

private theorem quadratic_form_value :
    z ⬝ᵥ ((meanProj P ^ 3 - symProd P) *ᵥ z) = -8 / 243 := by
  rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, mean_form, sym_form]
  norm_num

private theorem instance_not_posSemidef : ¬ (meanProj P ^ 3 - symProd P).PosSemidef := by
  intro h
  have hq := h.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg z
  have hz : star z = z := by ext i; simp [z]
  rw [hz, quadratic_form_value] at hq
  norm_num at hq

theorem result : ¬ claim := by
  intro h
  exact instance_not_posSemidef (h 3 3 P (by norm_num) instance_is_projection)


end
end D5.S3.Quantum.Matrix.ProjectionAMGMRefutation

universe u
variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  [CompleteSpace H] [Nontrivial H]

/-- The genuine mean with its base in the first argument. -/
noncomputable def mean (θ : ℝ) (B A : L H) : L H :=
  CFC.conjSqrt B ((CFC.conjSqrt (Ring.inverse B) A) ^ θ)

private lemma strict_of_pd {A : L H} (hA : A ∈ pdSet) : IsStrictlyPositive A :=
  (StarOrderedRing.isStrictlyPositive_iff_spectrum_pos A (ha := hA.1)).2 hA.2

/-- The local perspective has its base in its second argument. -/
theorem mean_eq_operatorPowerMean (θ : ℝ) {A B : L H}
    (hB : B ∈ pdSet) (hA : 0 ≤ A) :
    mean θ B A = OperatorGeometricMean.operatorPowerMean θ 1 A B := by
  have hsB := strict_of_pd hB

    rw [CFC.sqrt_eq_rpow, CFC.inverse_eq_rpow_neg_one hsB,
      CFC.rpow_rpow B (-1) (1 / 2) (by norm_num) hsB]
    norm_num
  have hm : 0 ≤ B ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) * A * B ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    (CFC.rpow_nonneg (a := B) (y := (-1 / 2 : ℝ))).isSelfAdjoint.conjugate_nonneg hA

    CFC.sqrt (Ring.inverse B)) ^ θ * CFC.sqrt B = _
  rw [hI, CFC.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  unfold OperatorGeometricMean.operatorPowerMean GeneralizedPerspective hSqrt hInvSqrt cfcR LownerHeinzCore.cfcR
  simp only [Real.rpow_one]
  rw [← CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real hsB.nonneg, ← CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real hsB.nonneg,
    ← CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real hm]

/-- Joint concavity of the genuine mean with the classical base-first convention. -/
theorem mean_jointlyConcave {θ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    JointlyConcaveOn (pdSet (ℋ := H)) (pdSet (ℋ := H)) (mean θ) := by
  intro B₀ B₁ A₀ A₁ t hB₀ hB₁ hA₀ hA₁ ht0 ht1
  have hBm := LiebAndoTrace.pdSet_convexCombo hB₀ hB₁ ht0 ht1
  have hAm := LiebAndoTrace.pdSet_convexCombo hA₀ hA₁ ht0 ht1
  rw [mean_eq_operatorPowerMean θ hB₀ (strict_of_pd hA₀).nonneg,
    mean_eq_operatorPowerMean θ hB₁ (strict_of_pd hA₁).nonneg,
    mean_eq_operatorPowerMean θ hBm (strict_of_pd hAm).nonneg]
  exact OperatorGeometricMean.operatorPowerMean_jointlyConcaveOn_pdSet
    hθ ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩ hA₀ hA₁ hB₀ hB₁ ht0 ht1

private lemma power_contraction {θ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    {D X : L H} (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hX : star X * X ≤ 1) :
    star X * D ^ θ * X ≤ (star X * D * X) ^ θ := by
  have hf : CondIciAll.{u} (fun x : ℝ ↦ -(x ^ θ)) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro K _ _ _ _
      exact power_Icc_zero_one_operatorConcaveOn_Ici θ hθ
    · intro x hx
      exact ((Real.continuousAt_rpow_const x θ (Or.inr hθ.1)).neg).continuousWithinAt
    · simp only [neg_nonpos]
      positivity
  have hn : ‖X‖ ≤ 1 := by
    have hn2 := (CStarAlgebra.norm_le_one_iff_of_nonneg (star X * X)
      (star_mul_self_nonneg X)).2 hX
    rw [CStarRing.norm_star_mul_self] at hn2
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg X]
  have hj := theorem_2_5_2_i_ici_all_imp_iv (ℋ := H) hf
    (IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg hD)
    ((StarOrderedRing.nonneg_iff_spectrum_nonneg (R := ℝ) D).1 hD) hn
  change cfc (fun x : ℝ ↦ -(x ^ θ)) (star X * D * X) ≤
    star X * cfc (fun x : ℝ ↦ -(x ^ θ)) D * X at hj
  rw [cfc_neg, cfc_neg, ← CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real (star_left_conjugate_nonneg hD X),
    ← CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real hD, mul_neg, neg_mul, neg_le_neg_iff] at hj
  exact hj

/-- Increasing the second input increases the genuine mean. -/
theorem mean_mono_right {θ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    {B A A' : L H} (hAA' : A ≤ A') : mean θ B A ≤ mean θ B A' := by
  exact CFC.conjSqrt_le_conjSqrt
    (CFC.rpow_le_rpow hθ (CFC.conjSqrt_le_conjSqrt hAA'))

/-- Increasing the positive definite base increases the genuine mean. -/
theorem mean_mono_left {θ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    {B B' A : L H} (hB : B ∈ pdSet) (hB' : B' ∈ pdSet)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hBB' : B ≤ B') : mean θ B A ≤ mean θ B' A := by
  have hsB := strict_of_pd hB
  have hsB' := strict_of_pd hB'
  let S := CFC.sqrt B
  let T := CFC.sqrt B'
  let I := CFC.sqrt (Ring.inverse B)
  let J := CFC.sqrt (Ring.inverse B')
  let D := CFC.conjSqrt (Ring.inverse B) A
  have hS : IsSelfAdjoint S := (CFC.sqrt_nonneg B).isSelfAdjoint
  have hT : IsSelfAdjoint T := (CFC.sqrt_nonneg B').isSelfAdjoint
  have hI : IsSelfAdjoint I := (CFC.sqrt_nonneg (Ring.inverse B)).isSelfAdjoint
  have hJ : IsSelfAdjoint J := (CFC.sqrt_nonneg (Ring.inverse B')).isSelfAdjoint
  have hIS : I * S = 1 := by
    dsimp [I, S]
    rw [CFC.sqrt_ringInverse]
    exact Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ (hsB.sqrt B).isUnit
  have hSI : S * I = 1 := by
    dsimp [I, S]
    rw [CFC.sqrt_ringInverse]
    exact Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ (hsB.sqrt B).isUnit
  have hJT : J * T = 1 := by
    dsimp [J, T]
    rw [CFC.sqrt_ringInverse]
    exact Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ (hsB'.sqrt B').isUnit
  have hTJ : T * J = 1 := by
    dsimp [J, T]
    rw [CFC.sqrt_ringInverse]
    exact Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ (hsB'.sqrt B').isUnit
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using (CFC.conjSqrt_monotone (c := Ring.inverse B) hA)
  have hcontract : star (S * J) * (S * J) ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      star (S * J) * (S * J) = CFC.conjSqrt (Ring.inverse B') B := by
        simp only [star_mul, hS.star_eq, hJ.star_eq, CFC.conjSqrt_apply]
        dsimp [S, J]
        rw [← mul_assoc, mul_assoc (CFC.sqrt (Ring.inverse B')),
          CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self B hsB.nonneg]
      _ ≤ CFC.conjSqrt (Ring.inverse B') B' := CFC.conjSqrt_le_conjSqrt hBB'
      _ = 1 := CFC.conjSqrt_ringInverse_self B' hsB'
  have hmiddle : star (S * J) * D * (S * J) =
      CFC.conjSqrt (Ring.inverse B') A := by
    simp only [star_mul, hS.star_eq, hJ.star_eq]
    change J * S * (I * A * I) * (S * J) = J * A * J
    calc
      _ = J * (S * I) * A * (I * S) * J := by noncomm_ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hSI, hIS]; simp

  rw [hmiddle] at hj
  have hc := hT.conjugate_le_conjugate hj
  change mean θ B A ≤ mean θ B' A
  change S * D ^ θ * S ≤ T * (CFC.conjSqrt (Ring.inverse B') A) ^ θ * T
  convert hc using 1
  simp only [star_mul, hS.star_eq, hJ.star_eq]
  symm
  calc
    _ = (T * J) * S * D ^ θ * S * (J * T) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hTJ, hJT]; simp

/-- Joint order monotonicity; no commutation of the two inputs is required. -/
theorem mean_mono {θ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    {B B' A A' : L H} (hB : B ∈ pdSet) (hB' : B' ∈ pdSet)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hBB' : B ≤ B') (hAA' : A ≤ A') :
    mean θ B A ≤ mean θ B' A' :=
  (mean_mono_left hθ hB hB' hA hBB').trans (mean_mono_right hθ hAA')

end HiaiGeometricMean

variable {n kappa : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    [Fintype kappa] [DecidableEq kappa]
    {P : kappa -> Matrix n n ℂ}

omit [DecidableEq n] in
private theorem trace_compressed_mul (A B Q : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    Matrix.trace ((Q * A * Q) * B) = Matrix.trace (A * (Q * B * Q)) := by
  calc
    Matrix.trace ((Q * A * Q) * B) = Matrix.trace (Q * A * (Q * B)) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = Matrix.trace ((Q * B) * Q * A) := Matrix.trace_mul_cycle Q A (Q * B)
    _ = Matrix.trace (A * ((Q * B) * Q)) := Matrix.trace_mul_comm ((Q * B) * Q) A
    _ = Matrix.trace (A * (Q * B * Q)) := by rfl

private theorem unreadState_conjTranspose (hP : IsRecordMeasurement P)
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (unreadState P X)ᴴ = unreadState P Xᴴ := by
  classical
  rw [unreadState, Matrix.conjTranspose_sum, unreadState]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  have hk : (P k)ᴴ = P k := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using hP.selfAdjoint k
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hk, Matrix.mul_assoc]

omit [DecidableEq kappa] in
private theorem unreadState_hilbert_schmidt_self_adjoint
    (hP : IsRecordMeasurement P) (X Y : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    Matrix.trace ((unreadState P X)ᴴ * Y) =
      Matrix.trace (Xᴴ * unreadState P Y) := by
  classical
  rw [unreadState_conjTranspose hP X, unreadState, Matrix.sum_mul,
    Matrix.trace_sum, unreadState, Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.trace_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  exact trace_compressed_mul Xᴴ Y (P k)

omit [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq kappa] in
private theorem unreadState_sub (X Y : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    unreadState P (X - Y) = unreadState P X - unreadState P Y := by
  classical
  simp [unreadState, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

    Matrix.trace ((A + B)ᴴ * C) =
      Matrix.trace (Aᴴ * C) + Matrix.trace (Bᴴ * C) := by
  simp [Matrix.add_mul]

    Matrix.trace (Aᴴ * (B + C)) =
      Matrix.trace (Aᴴ * B) + Matrix.trace (Aᴴ * C) := by
  simp [Matrix.mul_add]

omit [DecidableEq kappa] in
private theorem unreadState_hilbert_schmidt_orthogonal
    (hP : IsRecordMeasurement P) (X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    Matrix.trace ((unreadState P X)ᴴ * (X - unreadState P X)) = 0 := by
  have hInner :
      Matrix.trace ((unreadState P X)ᴴ * X) =
        Matrix.trace ((unreadState P X)ᴴ * unreadState P X) := by
    calc
      Matrix.trace ((unreadState P X)ᴴ * X) =
          Matrix.trace ((unreadState P (unreadState P X))ᴴ * X) := by
        rw [unreadState_idempotent hP X]
      _ = Matrix.trace ((unreadState P X)ᴴ * unreadState P X) :=
        unreadState_hilbert_schmidt_self_adjoint hP (unreadState P X) X
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.trace_sub, hInner, sub_self]

omit [DecidableEq kappa] in
private theorem unreadState_hilbert_schmidt_pythagorean
    (hP : IsRecordMeasurement P) (X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    hilbertSchmidtSquare X =
      hilbertSchmidtSquare (unreadState P X) +
        hilbertSchmidtSquare (X - unreadState P X) := by

  have hDecomp : X = unreadState P X + discarded := by
    dsimp [discarded]
    abel
  have hDiscarded : unreadState P discarded = 0 := by
    dsimp [discarded]
    rw [unreadState_sub, unreadState_idempotent hP X, sub_self]
  have hReverseOrthogonal :
      Matrix.trace (discardedᴴ * unreadState P X) = 0 := by
    calc
      Matrix.trace (discardedᴴ * unreadState P X) =
          Matrix.trace ((unreadState P discarded)ᴴ * X) :=
        (unreadState_hilbert_schmidt_self_adjoint hP discarded X).symm
      _ = 0 := by rw [hDiscarded]; simp
  have hComplex :
      Matrix.trace (Xᴴ * X) =
        Matrix.trace ((unreadState P X)ᴴ * unreadState P X) +
          Matrix.trace (discardedᴴ * discarded) := by
    calc
      Matrix.trace (Xᴴ * X) =
          Matrix.trace ((unreadState P X + discarded)ᴴ *
            (unreadState P X + discarded)) :=
        congrArg (fun A => Matrix.trace (Aᴴ * A)) hDecomp
      _ = (Matrix.trace ((unreadState P X)ᴴ * unreadState P X) +
            Matrix.trace ((unreadState P X)ᴴ * discarded)) +
          (Matrix.trace (discardedᴴ * unreadState P X) +
            Matrix.trace (discardedᴴ * discarded)) := by
        rw [hilbert_schmidt_add_left, hilbert_schmidt_add_right,

/-- A⁻¹ ♯ B = A⁻¹ᐟ² (A¹ᐟ² B A¹ᐟ²)¹ᐟ² A⁻¹ᐟ². -/
noncomputable def gmInv {n : ℕ} (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ :=
  cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) A *
    cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ))
      (cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) A * B *
        cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) A) *
    cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) A

/-- Definition 2.3: the alternative mean. -/
noncomputable def altMean {n : ℕ} (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ :=
  cfc f (gmInv A B) * A * cfc f (gmInv A B)

/-- Remark 2.2: linearizability. -/
def Linearizable {n : ℕ} (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ a b : ℝ, altMean f A B = a • A + b • B

/-- The property asked for in the source question. -/
def Rigid (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ), A.PosDef → B.PosDef →
    (Linearizable f A B ↔
      (A * B = B * A ∧ (spectrum ℝ (gmInv A B)).ncard ≤ 2))

private lemma half_eq_sqrt {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) : cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) A = CFC.sqrt A := by
  rw [CFC.sqrt_eq_rpow, CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real hA.posSemidef.nonneg]

private lemma half_inverse {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) :
    cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) A *
      cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) A = 1 ∧
    cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) A *
      cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) A = 1 := by
  rw [← CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real hA.posSemidef.nonneg,
    ← CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real hA.posSemidef.nonneg]
  exact ⟨CFC.rpow_mul_rpow_neg _ hA.isStrictlyPositive,
    CFC.rpow_neg_mul_rpow _ hA.isStrictlyPositive⟩

private lemma neg_half_pos {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) : (cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) A).PosDef := by
  rw [← CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real hA.posSemidef.nonneg]
  exact (hA.isStrictlyPositive.rpow A (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))).posDef

lemma riccati {n : ℕ} {A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) :
    (gmInv A B).PosDef ∧ gmInv A B * A * gmInv A B = B := by
  let S := CFC.sqrt A
  let T := cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) A
  have hS : S.PosDef := hA.isStrictlyPositive.sqrt.posDef
  have hT : T.PosDef := neg_half_pos hA
  have hST : S * T = 1 := by simpa only [half_eq_sqrt hA] using (half_inverse hA).1
  have hTS : T * S = 1 := by simpa only [half_eq_sqrt hA] using (half_inverse hA).2
  have hSS : S * S = A := CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self _ hA.posSemidef.nonneg
  have hM : (S * B * S).PosDef := by
    simpa only [star_eq_conjTranspose, hS.isHermitian.eq] using
      hS.isUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff.mpr hB
  have hR : (CFC.sqrt (S * B * S)).PosDef := hM.isStrictlyPositive.sqrt.posDef
  have hgm : gmInv A B = T * CFC.sqrt (S * B * S) * T := by
    simp only [gmInv, half_eq_sqrt hA, half_eq_sqrt hM, S, T]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hgm]
    simpa only [star_eq_conjTranspose, hT.isHermitian.eq] using
      hT.isUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff.mpr hR
  · rw [hgm, ← hSS]
    calc
      T * CFC.sqrt (S * B * S) * T * (S * S) *
          (T * CFC.sqrt (S * B * S) * T) =
          T * (CFC.sqrt (S * B * S) * CFC.sqrt (S * B * S)) * T := by
            simp only [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc T S, ← mul_assoc S T, hTS, one_mul, hST]
      _ = T * (S * B * S) * T := by rw [CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self _ hM.posSemidef.nonneg]
      _ = B := by simp only [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc T S, hTS, one_mul, hST, mul_one]

lemma riccati_unique {n : ℕ} {A B Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hY : Y.PosDef) (h : Y * A * Y = B) : gmInv A B = Y := by
  let S := CFC.sqrt A
  let T := cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) A
  have hS : S.PosDef := hA.isStrictlyPositive.sqrt.posDef
  have hST : S * T = 1 := by simpa only [half_eq_sqrt hA] using (half_inverse hA).1
  have hTS : T * S = 1 := by simpa only [half_eq_sqrt hA] using (half_inverse hA).2
  have hSS : S * S = A := CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self _ hA.posSemidef.nonneg
  have hSYS : (S * Y * S).PosDef := by
    simpa only [star_eq_conjTranspose, hS.isHermitian.eq] using
      hS.isUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff.mpr hY
  have hM : (S * B * S).PosDef := by
    rw [← h]
    have hB : (Y * A * Y).PosDef := by
      simpa only [star_eq_conjTranspose, hY.isHermitian.eq] using
        hY.isUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff.mpr hA
    simpa only [star_eq_conjTranspose, hS.isHermitian.eq] using
      hS.isUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff.mpr hB
  have hr : CFC.sqrt (S * B * S) = S * Y * S := by
    apply CFC.sqrt_unique _ hSYS.posSemidef.nonneg
    calc
      S * Y * S * (S * Y * S) = S * (Y * (S * S) * Y) * S := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = S * B * S := by rw [hSS, h]
  rw [gmInv, half_eq_sqrt hA]
  change T * cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (S * B * S) * T = Y
  rw [half_eq_sqrt hM, hr]
  simp only [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc T S, hTS, one_mul, hST, mul_one]

private lemma spectral_pos {n : ℕ} {A Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hY : Y.IsHermitian) :
    ((conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ hY.eigenvectorUnitary).symm A).PosDef := by
  have hu : IsUnit (star hY.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) := isUnit_coe.star
  have h := hu.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff.mpr hA
  simpa only [conjStarAlgAut_symm_apply, coe_star, star_star] using h

private lemma spectral_entries {n : ℕ} {A Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hY : Y.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (h : cfc f Y * A * cfc f Y = a • A + b • (Y * A * Y)) :
    ∀ i j, ((f (hY.eigenvalues i) * f (hY.eigenvalues j) - a -
      b * hY.eigenvalues i * hY.eigenvalues j : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      ((conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ hY.eigenvectorUnitary).symm A) i j = 0 := by

  have heY : e.symm Y = diagonal (fun i => (hY.eigenvalues i : ℂ)) := by
    exact (congrArg e.symm hY.spectral_theorem).trans (e.symm_apply_apply _)
  have heF : e.symm (cfc f Y) = diagonal (fun i => (f (hY.eigenvalues i) : ℂ)) := by
    rw [hY.cfc_eq, IsHermitian.cfc]
    exact e.symm_apply_apply _
  have he := congrArg e.symm h
  simp only [map_mul, map_add, map_smul, heY, heF] at he
  intro i j
  have hij := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ => M i j) he
  simp only [diagonal_mul, mul_diagonal, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply] at hij
  change ((f (hY.eigenvalues i) * f (hY.eigenvalues j) - a -
    b * hY.eigenvalues i * hY.eigenvalues j : ℝ) : ℂ) * e.symm A i j = 0
  simp only [Algebra.smul_def] at hij
  push_cast
  linear_combination hij

private lemma affine_three (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : StrictConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ioi 0) g ∨ StrictConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Ioi 0) g)

    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hxz with hxz | hxz <;>
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hyz with hyz | hyz

    | exact ho x z y hx hxz hyz ex ez ey
    | exact ho y x z hy hxy hxz ey ex ez
    | exact ho y z x hy hyz hxz ey ez ex
    | exact ho z x y hz hxz hxy ez ex ey

private lemma off_diagonal_factor (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hi : Set.InjOn f (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hq : Set.InjOn (fun x => f x / x) (Set.Ioi 0))
    (a b x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hne : x ≠ y)
    (ex : f x ^ 2 = a + b * x ^ 2) (ey : f y ^ 2 = a + b * y ^ 2) :
    f x * f y - a - b * x * y ≠ 0 := by
  intro he
  have hp : (f x - f y) * (y * f x - x * f y) = 0 := by
    linear_combination y * ex + x * ey - (x + y) * he
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hp with h | h
  · exact hne (hi hx hy (sub_eq_zero.mp h))
  · exact hne (hq hx hy ((div_eq_div_iff hx.ne' hy.ne').mpr (by linarith)))

private lemma necessary_spectrum_and_commute {n : ℕ} (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hi : Set.InjOn f (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hq : Set.InjOn (fun x => f x / x) (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hg : StrictConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ioi 0) (fun s => f (Real.sqrt s) ^ 2) ∨

    have hzero := (mul_eq_zero.mp (he i i)).resolve_right hc
    have hr := Complex.ofReal_eq_zero.mp hzero
    dsimp [t]
    nlinarith

    · intro heq; apply hxy; change t i = t j; nlinarith [ht i, ht j]
    · intro heq; apply hxz; change t i = t k; nlinarith [ht i, ht k]
    · intro heq; apply hyz; change t j = t k; nlinarith [ht j, ht k]

    · simpa only [Real.sqrt_sq (ht j).le] using hd j

  have heY : e.symm Y = diagonal (fun i => (t i : ℂ)) :=
    (congrArg e.symm hY.isHermitian.spectral_theorem).trans (e.symm_apply_apply _)
  have hCY : C * diagonal (fun i => (t i : ℂ)) = diagonal (fun i => (t i : ℂ)) * C := by
    ext i j
    simp only [mul_diagonal, diagonal_mul]
    by_cases hij : t i = t j

private lemma commute_gm {n : ℕ} {A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (h : Commute A B) : Commute A (gmInv A B) := by

  have hM := (hS.mul_right h).mul_right hS
  exact (hT.mul_right ((hM.symm.cfc_real _).symm)).mul_right hT

private lemma interpolate_two {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 < t i)

private lemma linearizable_of_commute_card {n : ℕ} (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    {A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef)
    (hcomm : A * B = B * A) (hcard : (spectrum ℝ (gmInv A B)).ncard ≤ 2) :
    Linearizable f A B := by
  let Y := gmInv A B
  have hY := (riccati hA hB).1
  have hAY : Commute A Y := commute_gm hcomm
  have hAF : Commute A (cfc f Y) := (hAY.symm.cfc_real f).symm
  have hc : (Set.range hY.isHermitian.eigenvalues).ncard ≤ 2 := by
    rwa [← hY.isHermitian.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := interpolate_two hY.isHermitian.eigenvalues hY.eigenvalues_pos hc f
  have hFF : cfc f Y * cfc f Y = a • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) + b • (Y * Y) := by
    let e := (conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ hY.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary).restrictScalars ℝ
    have heY : e.symm Y = diagonal (fun i => (hY.isHermitian.eigenvalues i : ℂ)) :=
      (congrArg e.symm hY.isHermitian.spectral_theorem).trans (e.symm_apply_apply _)
    have heF : e.symm (cfc f Y) = diagonal (fun i => (f (hY.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) : ℂ)) := by
      rw [hY.isHermitian.cfc_eq, IsHermitian.cfc]
      exact e.symm_apply_apply _
    apply e.symm.injective
    change e.symm (cfc f Y * cfc f Y) = e.symm (a • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) + b • (Y * Y))
    simp only [map_mul, map_add, map_smul, map_one, heY, heF]
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp only [diagonal_mul, diagonal_apply_eq, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
        Matrix.one_apply_eq, Complex.real_smul]
      simpa only [pow_two, Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.ofReal_mul, mul_one] using congrArg Complex.ofReal (hab i)
    · simp [Matrix.one_apply_ne hij, hij]
  refine ⟨a, b, ?_⟩
  change cfc f Y * A * cfc f Y = a • A + b • B
  rw [← hAF.eq, mul_assoc, hFF, mul_add, mul_smul_comm, mul_one, mul_smul_comm]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  rw [← mul_assoc, hAY.eq]
  exact (riccati hA hB).2

private lemma sufficient_rigid (f : ℝ → ℝ)

private lemma witness_pos : (!![2, 1; 1, 2] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ).PosDef := by
  let J : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 2) ℂ := !![1, 1]

private lemma witness_commute {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y)
    (h : (!![2, 1; 1, 2] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) *
      (diagonal ![(x : ℂ), (y : ℂ)] * !![2, 1; 1, 2] * diagonal ![(x : ℂ), (y : ℂ)]) =

  have he := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ => (M 0 1).re) h
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, diagonal, Complex.mul_re] at he
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - y)]

private lemma rigid_injective (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hR : Rigid f) : Set.InjOn f (Set.Ioi 0) := by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  let A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := !![2, 1; 1, 2]
  let Y : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := diagonal ![(x : ℂ), (y : ℂ)]
  have hY : Y.PosDef := by
    apply PosDef.diagonal
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [Y] using (show (0 : ℂ) < (x : ℂ) from by exact_mod_cast hx)
    · simpa [Y] using (show (0 : ℂ) < (y : ℂ) from by exact_mod_cast hy)
  have hB : (Y * A * Y).PosDef := by
    simpa only [star_eq_conjTranspose, hY.isHermitian.eq] using
      hY.isUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff.mpr witness_pos
  have hgm : gmInv A (Y * A * Y) = Y := riccati_unique witness_pos hY rfl
  have hF : cfc f Y = (f x) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) := by
    calc
      cfc f Y = cfc (fun _ : ℝ => f x) Y := by
        apply cfc_congr
        intro z hz
        have hz' : z ∈ Set.range ![x, y] := by
          have heq : Y = diagonal (fun i => ((![x, y] : Fin 2 → ℝ) i : ℂ)) := by
            ext i j
            fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> rfl
          rwa [heq, diagonal_real_spectrum] at hz
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hz'
        fin_cases i <;> simp [hxy]
      _ = _ := by
        simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
          cfc_const (R := ℝ) (f x) Y (show IsSelfAdjoint Y from hY.isHermitian)
  apply witness_commute hx hy
  exact (hR 2 A (Y * A * Y) witness_pos hB).mp ⟨(f x)^2, 0, by
    simp [altMean, hgm, hF, smul_smul, pow_two]⟩ |>.1

private lemma rigid_quotient_injective (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hR : Rigid f) :
    Set.InjOn (fun x => f x / x) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  let A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := !![2, 1; 1, 2]
  let Y : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := diagonal ![(x : ℂ), (y : ℂ)]
  have hY : Y.PosDef := by
    apply PosDef.diagonal
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [Y] using (show (0 : ℂ) < (x : ℂ) from by exact_mod_cast hx)
    · simpa [Y] using (show (0 : ℂ) < (y : ℂ) from by exact_mod_cast hy)
  have hB : (Y * A * Y).PosDef := by
    simpa only [star_eq_conjTranspose, hY.isHermitian.eq] using
      hY.isUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff.mpr witness_pos
  have hgm : gmInv A (Y * A * Y) = Y := riccati_unique witness_pos hY rfl
  have hF : cfc f Y = (f x / x) • Y := by
    calc
      cfc f Y = cfc (fun t : ℝ => (f x / x) * t) Y := by
        apply cfc_congr
        intro z hz
        have hz' : z ∈ Set.range ![x, y] := by
          have heq : Y = diagonal (fun i => ((![x, y] : Fin 2 → ℝ) i : ℂ)) := by
            ext i j
            fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> rfl
          rwa [heq, diagonal_real_spectrum] at hz
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hz'
        fin_cases i
        · simpa using (div_mul_cancel₀ (f x) (ne_of_gt hx)).symm
        · change f y = (f x / x) * y
          change f x / x = f y / y at hxy
          rw [hxy, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hy)]
      _ = _ := cfc_const_mul_id (f x / x) Y (show IsSelfAdjoint Y from hY.isHermitian)
  apply witness_commute hx hy
  exact (hR 2 A (Y * A * Y) witness_pos hB).mp ⟨0, (f x / x)^2, by
    simp [altMean, hgm, hF, smul_smul, pow_two]⟩ |>.1

private def diagHom (n : ℕ) : (Fin n → ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ where
  toAlgHom := diagonalAlgHom (n := Fin n) (α := ℂ) ℂ
  map_star' a := by ext i j; simp [diagonal]; split_ifs <;> simp_all

private lemma cfc_diag {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (f : ℝ → ℝ) (d : Fin n → ℝ) :
    cfc f (diagonal (fun i => (d i : ℂ))) = diagonal (fun i => (f (d i) : ℂ)) := by
  let : ContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℂ ℂ IsStarNormal := IsStarNormal.instContinuousFunctionalCalculus
  let : ContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) IsStarNormal := IsStarNormal.instContinuousFunctionalCalculus
  let : ContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℝ (Fin n → ℂ) IsSelfAdjoint := IsSelfAdjoint.instContinuousFunctionalCalculus
  have hc : ContinuousOn f (spectrum ℝ (fun i => (d i : ℂ))) := by
    apply Set.Finite.continuousOn _ f
    rw [Pi.spectrum_eq]
    apply Set.finite_iUnion
    intro i
    change (spectrum ℝ (algebraMap ℝ ℂ (d i))).Finite
    rw [CFC.spectrum_algebraMap_eq]
    exact Set.finite_singleton _
  have hmap := (diagHom n).map_cfc (p := IsSelfAdjoint) (q := IsSelfAdjoint) f (fun i => (d i : ℂ)) hc (by
    change Continuous (fun d : Fin n → ℂ => diagonal d)
    apply continuous_pi; intro i; apply continuous_pi; intro j
    by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [diagonal, h] <;> fun_prop) (by
      change star (fun i => (d i : ℂ)) = _
      ext i; simp) (by
      exact (isHermitian_diagonal_of_self_adjoint _ (by ext i; simp)).isSelfAdjoint)
  change cfc f ((diagHom n) (fun i => (d i : ℂ))) = _
  rw [← hmap, cfc_map_pi (S := ℂ) (p := IsSelfAdjoint) (q := fun _ => IsSelfAdjoint) f (fun i => (d i : ℂ)) (by simpa only [Pi.spectrum_eq] using hc)
    (by change star (fun i => (d i : ℂ)) = _; ext i; simp)
    (by intro i; change star (d i : ℂ) = _; simp)]
  change diagonal (fun i => cfc f (d i : ℂ)) = _
  congr 1
  funext i
  simpa using (cfc_algebraMap (A := ℂ) (d i) f)

private lemma rigid_no_collinear (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hr : Rigid f)
    (s t u : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hst : s < t) (htu : t < u) :
    (f (Real.sqrt t) ^ 2 - f (Real.sqrt s) ^ 2) / (t-s) ≠
    (f (Real.sqrt u) ^ 2 - f (Real.sqrt t) ^ 2) / (u-t) := by
  intro he
  let d : Fin 3 → ℝ := ![s,t,u]
  let Y : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ := diagonal (fun i => (Real.sqrt (d i) : ℂ))
  let B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ := diagonal (fun i => (d i : ℂ))
  have hd : ∀ i, 0 < d i := by intro i; fin_cases i <;> dsimp [d] <;> linarith
  have hY : Y.PosDef := .diagonal (fun i => by exact_mod_cast Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hd i))
  have hB : B.PosDef := .diagonal (fun i => by exact_mod_cast hd i)
  have hYY : Y * 1 * Y = B := by
    simp only [mul_one, Y, B, diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1; ext i
    exact_mod_cast Real.mul_self_sqrt (hd i).le
  have hgm : gmInv 1 B = Y := riccati_unique Matrix.PosDef.one hY hYY
  let b := (f (Real.sqrt t)^2 - f (Real.sqrt s)^2) / (t-s)
  let a := f (Real.sqrt s)^2 - b*s
  have hst0 : t-s ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have htu0 : u-t ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have ht : f (Real.sqrt t)^2 = a + b*t := by dsimp [a,b]; field_simp; ring
  have hu : f (Real.sqrt u)^2 = a + b*u := by
    have hb : f (Real.sqrt u)^2 - f (Real.sqrt t)^2 = b*(u-t) := by
      dsimp [b]; rw [he]; exact (div_mul_cancel₀ _ htu0).symm
    dsimp [a] at *; nlinarith
  have hlin : Linearizable f 1 B := by
    refine ⟨a,b,?_⟩
    rw [altMean, hgm]
    dsimp [Y]
    rw [cfc_diag]
    simp only [mul_one, diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i=j
    · subst j
      simp only [diagonal_apply_eq, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq,
        Complex.real_smul, mul_one, B, diagonal_apply_eq]
      have hi : f (Real.sqrt (d i))^2 = a + b*d i := by
        fin_cases i
        · dsimp [d,a]; ring
        · exact ht
        · exact hu
      exact_mod_cast (by simpa only [pow_two] using hi)
    · simp [diagonal, hij, B]
  have hcard := ((hr 3 1 B Matrix.PosDef.one hB).mp hlin).2
  rw [hgm, diagonal_real_spectrum] at hcard
  have hthree : 2 < (Set.range (fun i : Fin 3 => Real.sqrt (d i))).ncard := by
    apply (Set.two_lt_ncard (Set.finite_range _)).mpr
    refine ⟨Real.sqrt s, ⟨0,rfl⟩, Real.sqrt t, ⟨1,rfl⟩,
      Real.sqrt u, ⟨2,rfl⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt hs.le hst).ne
    · exact (Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt hs.le (hst.trans htu)).ne
    · exact (Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by linarith) htu).ne
  omega


private lemma strictConvex_or_strictConcave_of_no_collinear
    (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hc : ContinuousOn g (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hne : ∀ s t u : ℝ, 0 < s → s < t → t < u →
      (g t - g s) / (t - s) ≠ (g u - g t) / (u - t)) :
    StrictConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ioi 0) g ∨ StrictConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Ioi 0) g := by
  let T : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) := {p | 0 < p.1 ∧ p.1 < p.2.1 ∧ p.2.1 < p.2.2}
  let d : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ := fun p =>
    (g p.2.1 - g p.1) / (p.2.1 - p.1) -
      (g p.2.2 - g p.2.1) / (p.2.2 - p.2.1)
  have hT : Convex ℝ T := by
    intro p hp q hq a b ha hb hab
    simp only [T, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst,
      Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul] at *
    by_cases ha0 : a = 0
    · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
      simpa [ha0, hb1] using hq
    have ha' : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm ha0)
    constructor
    · exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (mul_pos ha' hp.1) (mul_nonneg hb hq.1.le)
    constructor
    · nlinarith [mul_pos ha' (sub_pos.mpr hp.2.1),
        mul_nonneg hb (sub_pos.mpr hq.2.1).le]
    · nlinarith [mul_pos ha' (sub_pos.mpr hp.2.2),
        mul_nonneg hb (sub_pos.mpr hq.2.2).le]
  have h0 : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => p.1) T := continuous_fst.continuousOn
  have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => p.2.1) T :=
    (continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd).continuousOn
  have h2 : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => p.2.2) T :=
    (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd).continuousOn
  have hg0 := hc.comp h0 (fun p hp => hp.1)
  have hg1 := hc.comp h1 (fun p hp => lt_trans hp.1 hp.2.1)
  have hg2 := hc.comp h2 (fun p hp => lt_trans (lt_trans hp.1 hp.2.1) hp.2.2)
  have hd : ContinuousOn d T :=
    ((hg1.sub hg0).div (h1.sub h0) (fun p hp => sub_ne_zero.mpr hp.2.1.ne')).sub
      ((hg2.sub hg1).div (h2.sub h1) (fun p hp => sub_ne_zero.mpr hp.2.2.ne'))
  have hdne : ∀ p ∈ T, d p ≠ 0 := by
    intro p hp
    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (hne p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2)
  rcases hT.isPreconnected.mapsTo_Ioi_or_Iio hd hdne with hpos | hneg
  · right
    apply strictConcaveOn_of_slope_strict_anti_adjacent (convex_Ioi 0)
    intro x y z hx hz hxy hyz
    have h := hpos (show (x, y, z) ∈ T from ⟨hx, hxy, hyz⟩)
    exact sub_pos.mp h
  · left
    apply strictConvexOn_of_slope_strict_mono_adjacent (convex_Ioi 0)
    intro x y z hx hz hxy hyz
    have h := hneg (show (x, y, z) ∈ T from ⟨hx, hxy, hyz⟩)
    exact sub_neg.mp h

/-- Characterization of the alternative means whose linearizability detects commutation
and at most two geometric spectral values, uniformly over complex matrix sizes. -/
theorem result (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hc : ContinuousOn f (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hpos : ∀ x, 0 < x → 0 < f x) (h1 : f 1 = 1) :
    Rigid f ↔ (Set.InjOn f (Set.Ioi 0) ∧
      Set.InjOn (fun x => f x / x) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧
      (StrictConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ioi 0) (fun s => f (Real.sqrt s) ^ 2) ∨
        StrictConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Ioi 0) (fun s => f (Real.sqrt s) ^ 2))) := by
  clear hpos h1
  constructor
  · intro hr
    refine ⟨rigid_injective f hr, rigid_quotient_injective f hr, ?_⟩
    apply strictConvex_or_strictConcave_of_no_collinear
    · exact (hc.comp Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousOn
        (fun s hs => Real.sqrt_pos.2 hs)).pow 2
    · exact rigid_no_collinear f hr
  · rintro ⟨hi, hq, hg⟩
    exact sufficient_rigid f hi hq hg

/-- The nested anticommutator `{A₀, {A₁, …, {A_{n-1}, A_n}…}}` of `n + 1` observables. -/
def nestedAnti {d : ℕ} :
    (n : ℕ) → (Fin (n + 1) → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ
  | 0, A => A 0
  | n + 1, A => A 0 * nestedAnti n (fun i => A i.succ) + nestedAnti n (fun i => A i.succ) * A 0

/-- The mean product of the pointer positions of `n + 1` sequential weak measurements of

noncomputable def pointerMean {d n : ℕ} (A : Fin (n + 1) → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (ψ : Fin d → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  (2 ^ n : ℝ)⁻¹ * (star ψ ⬝ᵥ (nestedAnti n A *ᵥ ψ)).re

projection observables and every pure state, the mean product of the pointer positions is at

/-- Real matrix power through the continuous functional calculus. -/
noncomputable def mpow (X : Matrix n n ℂ) (p : ℝ) : Matrix n n ℂ := cfc (fun t : ℝ => t ^ p) X
/-- The weighted geometric mean `A #_α B = A^{1/2} (A^{-1/2} B A^{-1/2})^α A^{1/2}`. -/
noncomputable def wgm (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) (α : ℝ) : Matrix n n ℂ :=
  mpow A (1 / 2) * mpow (mpow A (-1 / 2) * B * mpow A (-1 / 2)) α * mpow A (1 / 2)
/-- The weighted spectral geometric mean `Fα(A,B) = (A⁻¹ # B)^α A (A⁻¹ # B)^α`, equation (2.3). -/
noncomputable def specMean (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) (α : ℝ) : Matrix n n ℂ :=
  mpow (wgm A⁻¹ B (1 / 2)) α * A * mpow (wgm A⁻¹ B (1 / 2)) α
/-- `SGα,p(A,B) = Fα(A^p, B^p)^{1/p}`, equation (2.4). -/
noncomputable def SG (α p : ℝ) (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ :=
  mpow (specMean (mpow A p) (mpow B p) α) (1 / p)
/-- The Log-Euclidean mean `LEα(A,B) = exp((1 - α) log A + α log B)`. -/
noncomputable def LE (α : ℝ) (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ :=
  cfc Real.exp ((1 - α) • cfc Real.log A + α • cfc Real.log B)
/-- Log-majorization `X ≺log Y` for positive definite `X, Y`: the product of any `k`
eigenvalues of `X` is at most the product of some `k` eigenvalues of `Y` (equivalently, the
products of the `k` largest eigenvalues are ordered), and the determinants agree. -/
def LogMajorized {m : ℕ} (X Y : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) (hX : X.IsHermitian)
    (hY : Y.IsHermitian) : Prop :=
  (∀ s : Finset (Fin m), ∃ t : Finset (Fin m), t.card = s.card ∧
      ∏ i ∈ s, hX.eigenvalues i ≤ ∏ i ∈ t, hY.eigenvalues i) ∧ X.det = Y.det
/-- The open case of Problem 3.20: `SGα,p ≺log LEα` for every `α > 1`, `p > 0` and all positive
definite `A, B` (both means are Hermitian for such data). -/

    ← cfc_add A (fun x : ℝ => if x = 0 then 0 else (x + ε) ^ q)
      (fun x : ℝ => ε ^ q • (if x = 0 then 1 else 0))
      (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _)
      (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _)]
  apply cfc_congr
  intro x hx
  by_cases h : x = 0 <;> simp [h]

private lemma tendsto_positive_rpow {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι}
    {F : ι → Matrix d d ℂ} {M : Matrix d d ℂ} {q : ℝ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hM : M.PosSemidef) (hF : ∀ᶠ i in l, (F i).PosSemidef)
    (hlim : Tendsto F l (𝓝 M)) :
    Tendsto (fun i => F i ^ q) l (𝓝 (M ^ q)) := by
  let r : NNReal := ⟨q, hq.le⟩
  have h := (CFC.continuousOn_nnrpow (A := Matrix d d ℂ) r M hM.nonneg).tendsto
  have hl : Tendsto F l (𝓝[Set.Ici 0] M) :=
    tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hlim, hF.mono fun i hi => hi.nonneg⟩
  have hn : Tendsto (fun i => CFC.nnrpow (F i) r) l (𝓝 (CFC.nnrpow M r)) :=
    h.comp hl
  have heq (N : Matrix d d ℂ) : CFC.nnrpow N r = N ^ q :=
    CFC.nnrpow_eq_rpow (a := N) (x := r) (show 0 < r from hq)
  rw [heq M] at hn
  exact hn.congr' (.of_forall fun i => heq (F i))

private lemma psd_nested_rpow {A : Matrix d d ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (p q : ℝ) : (A ^ p) ^ q = A ^ (p * q) := by
  rw [CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real (CFC.rpow_nonneg (a := A) (y := p))]
  simp only [CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real hA.nonneg]
  rw [← cfc_comp' (fun x : ℝ => x ^ q) (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) A
    ((A.finite_real_spectrum.image _).continuousOn _)
    (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _) hA.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint]
  · apply cfc_congr
    intro x hx
    rw [hA.isHermitian.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at hx
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact (Real.rpow_mul (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i) p q).symm

private lemma regularized_inner_split {A B : Matrix d d ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    (hker : ∀ x : d → ℂ, A *ᵥ x = 0 → B *ᵥ x = 0)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (p : ℝ) :
    let R := cfc (fun x : ℝ => if x = 0 then 0 else (x + ε) ^ (-p / 2)) A
    (A + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) ^ (-p / 2) *
      (B + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) ^ p *
      (A + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) ^ (-p / 2) =
        R * (B + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) ^ p * R + (1 - spectralSupport A) := by
  let Q := 1 - spectralSupport A
  let R := cfc (fun x : ℝ => if x = 0 then 0 else (x + ε) ^ (-p / 2)) A
  let W := (B + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) ^ p
  obtain ⟨hqs, hqq, hqpos, haq, hbq⟩ := kernel_projection_data hA hker
  have hQ : Q = cfc (fun x : ℝ => if x = 0 then 1 else 0) A := by
    unfold Q spectralSupport
    rw [← cfc_const_one ℝ A hA.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint,
      ← cfc_sub (fun _ : ℝ => 1) (fun x : ℝ => if x = 0 then 0 else 1) A
        (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _) (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _)]
    apply cfc_congr
    intro x hx
    by_cases h : x = 0 <;> simp [h]
  have hrq : R * Q = 0 := by
    rw [hQ]
    unfold R
    rw [← cfc_mul _ _ A
      (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _) (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _)]
    calc
      _ = cfc (fun _ : ℝ => 0) A := by
        apply cfc_congr
        intro x hx
        by_cases h : x = 0 <;> simp [h]
      _ = 0 := cfc_const_zero ℝ A
  have hrs : Rᴴ = R := (cfc_predicate _ A : IsSelfAdjoint R).star_eq
  have hqr : Q * R = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hrq
    simpa [Q, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hrs, hqs] using h
  have hBe : (B + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)).PosSemidef :=
    hB.add (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.smul hε.le)
  have hwq : W * Q = ε ^ p • Q := by
    apply rpow_on_eigenmatrix hBe
    simp [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, hbq, Q]
  have hwqs : Q * W = ε ^ p • Q := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hwq
    have hws : Wᴴ = W := (CFC.rpow_nonneg (a := B + ε • 1) (y := p)).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
    simpa [Q, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, hqs, hws] using h
  have hrwq : R * W * Q = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hwq, Matrix.mul_smul, hrq, smul_zero]
  have hqwr : Q * W * R = 0 := by
    rw [hwqs, Matrix.smul_mul, hqr, smul_zero]
  have hqwq : Q * W * Q = ε ^ p • Q := by
    rw [hwqs, Matrix.smul_mul, hqq]
  have hc : ε ^ (-p / 2) * ε ^ p * ε ^ (-p / 2) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hε, ← Real.rpow_add hε]
    have he : -p / 2 + p + -p / 2 = 0 := by ring
    rw [he, Real.rpow_zero]
  simp only [inverse_shift_split hA hε]
  change (R + ε ^ (-p / 2) • Q) * W * (R + ε ^ (-p / 2) • Q) =
    R * W * R + Q
  simp only [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul,
    hrwq, hqwr, hqwq, smul_zero, zero_add, add_zero, smul_smul]
  rw [show ε ^ (-p / 2) * (ε ^ (-p / 2) * ε ^ p) = 1 by nlinarith [hc], one_smul]


private lemma support_power_sandwich {A B : Matrix d d ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (α : ℝ) :
    let U := A ^ (p / 2)
    let S := A ^ (-p / 2) * B ^ p * A ^ (-p / 2)
    U * (S + (1 - spectralSupport A)) ^ α * U = U * S ^ α * U := by
  let Q := 1 - spectralSupport A
  let P := 1 - Q
  let U := A ^ (p / 2)
  let R := A ^ (-p / 2)
  let S := R * B ^ p * R
  obtain ⟨hqs, hqq, hqpos, haq, hbq⟩ := kernel_projection_data (B := A) hA (fun _ hx => hx)
  have huq : U * Q = 0 := by
    simpa [U, Real.zero_rpow (by positivity : p / 2 ≠ 0)] using
      rpow_on_eigenmatrix hA 0 (p / 2) (by simpa using haq)
  have hrq : R * Q = 0 := by
    simpa [R, Real.zero_rpow (by linarith : -p / 2 ≠ 0)] using
      rpow_on_eigenmatrix hA 0 (-p / 2) (by simpa using haq)
  have hus : Uᴴ = U := (CFC.rpow_nonneg (a := A) (y := p / 2)).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
  have hrs : Rᴴ = R := (CFC.rpow_nonneg (a := A) (y := -p / 2)).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
  have hqu : Q * U = 0 := by
    simpa [Q, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hus, hqs] using congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose huq
  have hqr : Q * R = 0 := by
    simpa [Q, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hrs, hqs] using congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hrq
  have hsq : S * Q = 0 := by simp [S, Matrix.mul_assoc, hrq]
  have hqs' : Q * S = 0 := by simp [S, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hqr]
  have hup : U * P = U := by simp [P, Matrix.mul_sub, huq]
  have hpu : P * U = U := by simp [P, Matrix.sub_mul, hqu]
  have hspos : S.PosSemidef := by
    simpa [S, hrs] using
      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (CFC.rpow_nonneg (a := B) (y := p))).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same R
  have htpos : (S + Q).PosSemidef := hspos.add hqpos
  have hrel : (S + Q) * P = P * S := by
    calc
      (S + Q) * P = S + Q - Q * Q := by
        simp [P, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.add_mul, hsq]
      _ = S := by
        rw [show Q * Q = Q from hqq, add_sub_cancel_right]
      _ = P * S := by
        change S = (1 - Q) * S
        rw [sub_mul, one_mul, hqs', sub_zero]

  let e := Fintype.equivFin d
  let φ : Matrix d d ℂ ≃⋆ₐ[ℝ] Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card d)) (Fin (Fintype.card d)) ℂ :=
    { __ := Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv ℝ ℂ e
      map_star' := fun M => by rfl
      map_smul' := fun r M => by rfl }
  have hφ : Continuous φ := by
    change Continuous (fun M : Matrix d d ℂ => M.submatrix e.symm e.symm)
    fun_prop
  have hmap (M : Matrix d d ℂ) (hM : M.IsHermitian) :
      φ (cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ α) M) = cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ α) (φ M) :=
    StarAlgHomClass.map_cfc φ _ M (M.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _) hφ
      hM.isSelfAdjoint (hM.submatrix e.symm).isSelfAdjoint
  have ht' : (φ (S + Q)).IsHermitian := htpos.isHermitian.submatrix e.symm
  have hs' : (φ S).IsHermitian := hspos.isHermitian.submatrix e.symm
  have hrel' : φ (S + Q) * φ P = φ P * φ S := by
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, hrel]
  have hi' := cfc_intertwining ht' hs' (φ P) hrel' (fun x : ℝ => x ^ α)
  rw [← Matrix.IsHermitian.cfc_eq, ← Matrix.IsHermitian.cfc_eq] at hi'
  have hi : (S + Q) ^ α * P = P * S ^ α := by
    have heq : φ ((S + Q) ^ α * P) = φ (P * S ^ α) := by
      rw [map_mul, map_mul]
      rw [CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real htpos.nonneg, CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real hspos.nonneg]
      rw [hmap (S + Q) htpos.isHermitian, hmap S hspos.isHermitian]
      exact hi'
    exact φ.injective heq
  change U * (S + Q) ^ α * U = U * S ^ α * U
  calc
    _ = U * ((S + Q) ^ α * P) * U := by simp [Matrix.mul_assoc, hpu]
    _ = U * (P * S ^ α) * U := by rw [hi]
    _ = U * S ^ α * U := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hup]

set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
-- The finite-spectrum CFC transport and the two-sided matrix limit elaborate together.
private lemma geometric_mean_regularization_tendsto {A B : Matrix d d ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    (hker : ∀ x : d → ℂ, A *ᵥ x = 0 → B *ᵥ x = 0)
    {α p : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hp : 0 < p) :
    Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => geometricMean α
      ((A + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) ^ p)
      ((B + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) ^ p))
      (𝓝[Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)] 0) (𝓝 (geometricMean α (A ^ p) (B ^ p))) := by
  let Q := 1 - spectralSupport A
  let R (ε : ℝ) :=
    cfc (fun x : ℝ => if x = 0 then 0 else (x + ε) ^ (-p / 2)) A
  let W (ε : ℝ) := (B + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) ^ p
  let S (ε : ℝ) := R ε * W ε * R ε + Q
  let U (ε : ℝ) := (A + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) ^ (p / 2)
  let R₀ := A ^ (-p / 2)
  let U₀ := A ^ (p / 2)
  let S₀ := R₀ * B ^ p * R₀ + Q
  have he : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => ε) (𝓝[Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)] 0) (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_id.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hadd (M : Matrix d d ℂ) :
      Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => M + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ))
        (𝓝[Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)] 0) (𝓝 M) := by
    have hconst : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ => M) (𝓝[Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)] 0) (𝓝 M) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds
    have hone : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : Matrix d d ℂ))
        (𝓝[Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)] 0) (𝓝 (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) := tendsto_const_nhds
    simpa using hconst.add (he.smul hone)
  have hshift (M : Matrix d d ℂ) (hM : M.PosSemidef) :
      ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in (𝓝[Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)] 0), (M + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)).PosSemidef := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ε hε
    exact hM.add (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.smul (le_of_lt hε))
  have hR : Tendsto R (𝓝[Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)] 0) (𝓝 R₀) :=
    support_rpow_shift_tendsto hA (by linarith)
  have hW : Tendsto W (𝓝[Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)] 0) (𝓝 (B ^ p)) :=
    tendsto_positive_rpow hp hB (hshift B hB) (hadd B)
  have hU : Tendsto U (𝓝[Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)] 0) (𝓝 U₀) :=
    tendsto_positive_rpow (by positivity) hA (hshift A hA) (hadd A)
  have hS : Tendsto S (𝓝[Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)] 0) (𝓝 S₀) :=
    ((hR.mul hW).mul hR).add_const Q
  obtain ⟨hqs, hqq, hqpos, haq, hbq⟩ := kernel_projection_data hA hker
  have hSpos : ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in (𝓝[Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)] 0), (S ε).PosSemidef := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ε hε
    have hr : (R ε)ᴴ = R ε := (cfc_predicate _ A : IsSelfAdjoint (R ε)).star_eq
    have hw : (W ε).PosSemidef :=
      Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp CFC.rpow_nonneg
    exact (by simpa [S, hr] using (hw.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same (R ε)).add hqpos)
  have hS₀pos : S₀.PosSemidef := by
    have hr : R₀ᴴ = R₀ := (CFC.rpow_nonneg (a := A) (y := -p / 2)).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
    have hw : (B ^ p).PosSemidef := Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp CFC.rpow_nonneg
    simpa [S₀, hr] using (hw.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same R₀).add hqpos
  have hpow := tendsto_positive_rpow hα hS₀pos hSpos hS
  have hlim := (hU.mul hpow).mul hU
  have heq : ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in (𝓝[Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)] 0),
      geometricMean α ((A + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) ^ p)
        ((B + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) ^ p) = U ε * (S ε) ^ α * U ε := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ε hε
    have hAe : (A + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)).PosSemidef :=
      hA.add (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.smul (le_of_lt hε))
    simp only [geometricMean, psd_nested_rpow hAe]
    simp only [show p * (1 / 2 : ℝ) = p / 2 by ring,
      show p * (-1 / 2 : ℝ) = -p / 2 by ring]
    rw [regularized_inner_split hA hB hker hε]
  have htarget : U₀ * S₀ ^ α * U₀ = geometricMean α (A ^ p) (B ^ p) := by
    rw [support_power_sandwich hA hp]
    simp only [geometricMean, psd_nested_rpow hA]
    simp [U₀, R₀, S₀, show p * (1 / 2 : ℝ) = p / 2 by ring,
      show p * (-1 / 2 : ℝ) = -p / 2 by ring]
    ring_nf
  rw [htarget] at hlim
  refine hlim.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [heq] with ε hε
  exact hε.symm


private lemma mean_posSemidef (X Y : Matrix d d ℂ) (α : ℝ) : (geometricMean α X Y).PosSemidef := by
  have hs : (X ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ))ᴴ = X ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    (CFC.rpow_nonneg (a := X) (y := 1 / 2)).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
  have hpow : ((X ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) * Y * X ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ α).PosSemidef :=
    Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp CFC.rpow_nonneg
  have h := hpow.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same (X ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ))
  rw [geometricMean]
  rw [hs] at h
  exact h

private lemma tendsto_tracePower {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι}
    {F : ι → Matrix d d ℂ} {M : Matrix d d ℂ} {q : ℝ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hM : M.PosSemidef) (hF : ∀ᶠ i in l, (F i).PosSemidef)
    (hlim : Tendsto F l (𝓝 M)) :
    Tendsto (fun i => tracePower q (F i)) l (𝓝 (tracePower q M)) := by
  have hpow : Tendsto (fun i => F i ^ q) l (𝓝 (M ^ q)) :=
    tendsto_positive_rpow hq hM hF hlim
  have hc : Continuous (fun N : Matrix d d ℂ => (Matrix.trace N).re) :=
    Complex.continuous_re.comp continuous_id.matrix_trace
  exact hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hpow

private lemma geometric_trace_regularization_tendsto {A B : Matrix d d ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    (hker : ∀ x : d → ℂ, A *ᵥ x = 0 → B *ᵥ x = 0)
    {α p : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hp : 0 < p) :
    Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => geometricTrace α p
      (A + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) (B + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)))
      (𝓝[Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)] 0) (𝓝 (geometricTrace α p A B)) := by
  apply tendsto_tracePower (one_div_pos.mpr hp)
  · exact mean_posSemidef (A ^ p) (B ^ p) α
  · exact .of_forall fun ε => mean_posSemidef
      ((A + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) ^ p)
      ((B + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) ^ p) α
  · exact geometric_mean_regularization_tendsto hA hB hker hα hp


/-- PSD pairs with the second input supported on the first input's support. -/
def supportPairDomain : Set (Matrix d d ℂ × Matrix d d ℂ) :=
  {z | z.1.PosSemidef ∧ z.2.PosSemidef ∧
    ∀ x : d → ℂ, z.1 *ᵥ x = 0 → z.2 *ᵥ x = 0}

private lemma geometric_trace_support_convex_of_regularization
    {α p : ℝ} (hα : α ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2)
    (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (1 / 2 : ℝ) 1)
    (hreg : ∀ {A B : Matrix d d ℂ}, A.PosSemidef → B.PosSemidef →
      (∀ x : d → ℂ, A *ᵥ x = 0 → B *ᵥ x = 0) →
      Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => geometricTrace α p
        (A + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) (B + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)))
        (𝓝[Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)] 0) (𝓝 (geometricTrace α p A B))) :
    ConvexOn ℝ supportPairDomain
      (fun z : Matrix d d ℂ × Matrix d d ℂ => geometricTrace α p z.1 z.2) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z₀ hz₀ z₁ hz₁ a b ha hb hab
    obtain ⟨hA, hB, hk⟩ := support_pair_mix hz₀.1 hz₁.1 hz₀.2.1 hz₁.2.1
      hz₀.2.2 hz₁.2.2 hb (by linarith)
    have hea : a = 1 - b := by linarith
    simpa [supportPairDomain, hea] using And.intro hA (And.intro hB hk)
  intro z₀ hz₀ z₁ hz₁ a b ha hb hab
  rcases hz₀ with ⟨hA₀, hB₀, hker₀⟩
  rcases hz₁ with ⟨hA₁, hB₁, hker₁⟩
  have ht₁ : b ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hea : a = 1 - b := by linarith
  let Aₘ := (1 - b) • z₀.1 + b • z₁.1
  let Bₘ := (1 - b) • z₀.2 + b • z₁.2
  obtain ⟨hAm, hBm, hkerm⟩ :=
    support_pair_mix hA₀ hA₁ hB₀ hB₁ hker₀ hker₁ hb ht₁
  have hpd (X : Matrix d d ℂ) (hX : X.PosSemidef) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
      (X + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)).PosDef := by
    exact (Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hε).posSemidef_add hX
  have hineq : ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in (𝓝[Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)] 0),
      geometricTrace α p (Aₘ + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ))
        (Bₘ + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) ≤
      (1 - b) * geometricTrace α p (z₀.1 + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ))
          (z₀.2 + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) +
        b * geometricTrace α p (z₁.1 + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ))
          (z₁.2 + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ε hε
    have hspd : JointlyConvexOn {A : Matrix d d ℂ | A.PosDef}
        {B : Matrix d d ℂ | B.PosDef} (geometricTrace α p) :=
      geometric_trace_jointly_convex hα hp
    have h0 := hspd
      (A₁ := z₀.1 + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ))
      (A₂ := z₁.1 + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ))
      (B₁ := z₀.2 + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ))
      (B₂ := z₁.2 + ε • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) (θ := b)
      (hpd _ hA₀ ε hε) (hpd _ hA₁ ε hε)
      (hpd _ hB₀ ε hε) (hpd _ hB₁ ε hε) hb ht₁
    have hm (M N : Matrix d d ℂ) :
        (1 - b) • (M + ε • 1) + b • (N + ε • 1) =
          (1 - b) • M + b • N + ε • 1 := by module
    rw [hm, hm] at h0
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using h0
  have hL := (hreg hA₀ hB₀ hker₀).const_mul (1 - b) |>.add

  ⟨((pd_strict hX).rpow X s).isSelfAdjoint, fun _ hx ↦ ((pd_strict hX).rpow X s).spectrum_pos hx⟩

/-- The jointly concave Lieb lift, using the genuine HS inner product. -/
noncomputable def powerProduct (p : ℝ) (A W : L H) : L (HSOp H) :=
  lr (A ^ p) (W ^ (1 - p))

private lemma product_pd (p : ℝ) {A W : L H} (hA : A ∈ pdSet) (hW : W ∈ pdSet) :
    powerProduct p A W ∈ pdSet := lr_pd (pd_power p hA) (pd_power (1 - p) hW)

private lemma product_concave {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    JointlyConcaveOn (pdSet (ℋ := H)) (pdSet (ℋ := H)) (powerProduct p) := by
  intro A₀ A₁ W₀ W₁ t hA₀ hA₁ hW₀ hW₁ ht0 ht1
  have hAm := pdSet_convexCombo hA₀ hA₁ ht0 ht1
  have hWm := pdSet_convexCombo hW₀ hW₁ ht0 ht1
  have hc := operatorPowerMean_jointlyConcaveOn_pdSet (ℋ := HSOp H) (α := p) (β := 1)
    hp ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩ (leftMulHS_pdSet hA₀) (leftMulHS_pdSet hA₁)
    (rightMulHS_pdSet hW₀) (rightMulHS_pdSet hW₁) ht0 ht1
  have hleft : (1 - t) • leftMulHS A₀ + t • leftMulHS A₁ =
      leftMulHS ((1 - t) • A₀ + t • A₁) := by
    ext V
    change (1 - t) • (A₀ * toOp V) + t • (A₁ * toOp V) =
      ((1 - t) • A₀ + t • A₁) * toOp V
    rw [add_mul, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc]
  have hright : (1 - t) • rightMulHS W₀ + t • rightMulHS W₁ =
      rightMulHS ((1 - t) • W₀ + t • W₁) := by
    ext V
    change (1 - t) • (toOp V * W₀) + t • (toOp V * W₁) =
      toOp V * ((1 - t) • W₀ + t • W₁)
    rw [mul_add, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm]
  rw [hleft, hright, perspective_lr_eq p hA₀ hW₀, perspective_lr_eq p hA₁ hW₁,
    perspective_lr_eq p hAm hWm] at hc
  exact hc

/-- The two Lieb lifts are mixed together before evaluating at a vector. -/
theorem meanProduct_triple_concave {p θ t : ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    {A₀ A₁ B₀ B₁ W₀ W₁ : L H}
    (hA₀ : A₀ ∈ pdSet) (hA₁ : A₁ ∈ pdSet)
    (hB₀ : B₀ ∈ pdSet) (hB₁ : B₁ ∈ pdSet)
    (hW₀ : W₀ ∈ pdSet) (hW₁ : W₁ ∈ pdSet) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    (1 - t) • mean θ (powerProduct p B₀ W₀) (powerProduct p A₀ W₀) +
      t • mean θ (powerProduct p B₁ W₁) (powerProduct p A₁ W₁) ≤
      mean θ (powerProduct p ((1 - t) • B₀ + t • B₁) ((1 - t) • W₀ + t • W₁))
        (powerProduct p ((1 - t) • A₀ + t • A₁) ((1 - t) • W₀ + t • W₁)) := by
  have hPA₀ := product_pd p hA₀ hW₀
  have hPA₁ := product_pd p hA₁ hW₁
  have hPB₀ := product_pd p hB₀ hW₀
  have hPB₁ := product_pd p hB₁ hW₁
  have hPBm := product_pd p (pdSet_convexCombo hB₀ hB₁ ht0 ht1)
    (pdSet_convexCombo hW₀ hW₁ ht0 ht1)
  exact (mean_jointlyConcave hθ hPB₀ hPB₁ hPA₀ hPA₁ ht0 ht1).trans
    (mean_mono hθ (pdSet_convexCombo hPB₀ hPB₁ ht0 ht1) hPBm
      (pd_strict (pdSet_convexCombo hPA₀ hPA₁ ht0 ht1)).nonneg
      (product_concave hp hB₀ hB₁ hW₀ hW₁ ht0 ht1)
      (product_concave hp hA₀ hA₁ hW₀ hW₁ ht0 ht1))

/-- The triple pairing permits arbitrary `Z`, including singular and zero operators. -/
noncomputable def gamma (p θ : ℝ) (Z A B W : L H) : ℝ :=
  traceRe (star Z * mean θ (B ^ p) (A ^ p) * Z * W ^ (1 - p))

private lemma phi_lr (Z M D : L H) : phiK (star Z) (lr M D) = traceRe (star Z * M * Z * D) := by
  unfold phiK lr traceRe
  simp only [star_star]
  change (inner ℂ (ofOp Z) (ofOp (M * (Z * D)))).re = _
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using
    re_hsInner_eq_traceRe (ℋ := H) (X := Z) (Y := M * (Z * D))

private lemma phi_meanProduct (p θ : ℝ) (Z : L H) {A B W : L H}
    (hA : A ∈ pdSet) (hB : B ∈ pdSet) (hW : W ∈ pdSet) :
    phiK (star Z) (mean θ (powerProduct p B W) (powerProduct p A W)) = gamma p θ Z A B W := by
  unfold powerProduct
  rw [mean_lr_common θ (pd_power p hB) (pd_power p hA) (pd_power (1 - p) hW), phi_lr]
  rfl

/-- Gamma is jointly concave in all three positive definite inputs, with one shared mixture. -/
theorem hs_gamma_triple_concave {p θ t : ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (Z : L H)
    {A₀ A₁ B₀ B₁ W₀ W₁ : L H}
    (hA₀ : A₀ ∈ pdSet) (hA₁ : A₁ ∈ pdSet)
    (hB₀ : B₀ ∈ pdSet) (hB₁ : B₁ ∈ pdSet)
    (hW₀ : W₀ ∈ pdSet) (hW₁ : W₁ ∈ pdSet) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    (1 - t) * gamma p θ Z A₀ B₀ W₀ + t * gamma p θ Z A₁ B₁ W₁ ≤
      gamma p θ Z ((1 - t) • A₀ + t • A₁) ((1 - t) • B₀ + t • B₁)
        ((1 - t) • W₀ + t • W₁) := by
  have h := phiK_mono (star Z)
    (meanProduct_triple_concave hp hθ hA₀ hA₁ hB₀ hB₁ hW₀ hW₁ ht0 ht1)
  rw [phiK_add, phiK_smul, phiK_smul,
    phi_meanProduct p θ Z hA₀ hB₀ hW₀, phi_meanProduct p θ Z hA₁ hB₁ hW₁,
    phi_meanProduct p θ Z (pdSet_convexCombo hA₀ hA₁ ht0 ht1)
      (pdSet_convexCombo hB₀ hB₁ ht0 ht1) (pdSet_convexCombo hW₀ hW₁ ht0 ht1)] at h
  exact h

#print axioms hs_gamma_triple_concave
end HiaiHSMeanTrace

namespace D5.S3.Quantum.Hiai.ForwardTraceYoung
open scoped MatrixOrder Matrix.Norms.L2Operator ComplexOrder
open Matrix D5.S3.Quantum.Hiai.InverseMeanVariational
variable {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
local instance : Pow (Matrix d d ℂ) ℝ := ⟨CFC.rpow⟩

/-- The maximized forward trace-Young objective. -/
def objective (p : ℝ) (M W : Matrix d d ℂ) : ℝ :=
  (Matrix.trace (M * W ^ (1 - p))).re - (1 - p) * (Matrix.trace W).re

private lemma holder_trace {M W : Matrix d d ℂ} (hM : M.PosDef) (hW : W.PosDef)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) :
    (Matrix.trace (M * W ^ (1 - p))).re ≤
      tracePower (1 / p) M ^ p * (Matrix.trace W).re ^ (1 - p) ∧
    0 ≤ tracePower (1 / p) M ∧ 0 ≤ (Matrix.trace W).re := by
  let U := M ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  let V := W ^ ((1 - p) / 2)
  let a := 2 / p
  let b := 2 / (1 - p)
  have ha : 0 < a := by dsimp [a]; positivity
  have hb : 0 < b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
  have hU : Uᴴ = U := (IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg (CFC.rpow_nonneg (a := M))).star_eq
  have hV : Vᴴ = V := (IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg (CFC.rpow_nonneg (a := W))).star_eq
  have hUU : U * U = M := by
    dsimp [U]
    rw [← CFC.rpow_add hM.isUnit]
    norm_num
    exact CFC.rpow_one M hM.posSemidef.nonneg
  have hVV : V * V = W ^ (1 - p) := by
    dsimp [V]
    rw [← CFC.rpow_add hW.isUnit]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hUV : schattenNorm (U * V) 2 ^ (2 : ℝ) =
      (Matrix.trace (M * W ^ (1 - p))).re := by
    rw [norm_rpow_gram _ (by norm_num)]
    norm_num only [tracePower, show (2 : ℝ) / 2 = 1 by norm_num]
    rw [CFC.rpow_one _ (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self (U * V)).nonneg,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hU, hV]
    have hg : V * U * (U * V) = V * M * V := by
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_assoc V U U, hUU]
    rw [hg, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, Matrix.trace_mul_comm (V * V) M, hVV]
  have hnormU : schattenNorm U a ^ a = tracePower (1 / p) M := by
    rw [norm_rpow_gram _ ha, hU, hUU]
    congr 1
    dsimp [a]
    ring
  have hnormV : schattenNorm V b ^ b = (Matrix.trace W).re := by
    rw [norm_rpow_gram _ hb, hV, hVV]
    dsimp [tracePower]
    rw [CFC.rpow_rpow W (1 - p) (b / 2) (by linarith) hW.isStrictlyPositive]
    have he : (1 - p) * (b / 2) = 1 := by dsimp [b]; field_simp [show 1 - p ≠ 0 by linarith]
    rw [he, CFC.rpow_one W hW.posSemidef.nonneg]
  have hTM : 0 ≤ tracePower (1 / p) M := by
    rw [← hnormU]
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg (schattenNorm_nonneg U _) _
  have hTW : 0 ≤ (Matrix.trace W).re := by
    rw [← hnormV]
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg (schattenNorm_nonneg V _) _
  have hh := schattenNorm_mul_le U V (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) ha hb
    (by dsimp [a, b]; field_simp; ring : 1 / (2 : ℝ) = 1 / a + 1 / b)
  have hh2 := Real.rpow_le_rpow (schattenNorm_nonneg (U * V) _) hh (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
  rw [hUV, Real.mul_rpow (schattenNorm_nonneg U _) (schattenNorm_nonneg V _)] at hh2
  have heU : schattenNorm U  a ^ (2 : ℝ) = tracePower (1 / p) M ^ p := by
    rw [← hnormU, ← Real.rpow_mul (schattenNorm_nonneg U _)]
    have he : a * p = 2 := by dsimp [a]; field_simp
    rw [he]
  have heV : schattenNorm V b ^ (2 : ℝ) = (Matrix.trace W).re ^ (1 - p) := by
    rw [← hnormV, ← Real.rpow_mul (schattenNorm_nonneg V _)]
    have he : b * (1 - p) = 2 := by dsimp [b]; field_simp [show 1 - p ≠ 0 by linarith]
    rw [he]
  exact ⟨by simpa only [heU, heV] using hh2, hTM, hTW⟩

/-- Universal forward Young bound for arbitrary noncommuting positive definite matrices. -/
theorem forward_trace_young {M W : Matrix d d ℂ} (hM : M.PosDef) (hW : W.PosDef)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    objective p M W ≤ p * tracePower (1 / p) M := by
  by_cases h1 : p = 1
  · subst p
    simp [objective, tracePower, CFC.rpow_one M hM.posSemidef.nonneg,
      CFC.rpow_zero W hW.posSemidef.nonneg]
  · have hp1' : p < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hp1 h1
    obtain ⟨hh, hTM, hTW⟩ := holder_trace hM hW hp hp1'
    have hy := Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean2_weighted hp.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hp1)
      hTM hTW (by ring : p + (1 - p) = 1)
    unfold objective
    linarith

/-- The strictly positive optimizer is exactly `M^(1/p)`, including the endpoint `p=1`. -/
theorem maximum_and_attainment {M : Matrix d d ℂ} (hM : M.PosDef)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    ∃ W₀ : Matrix d d ℂ, W₀.PosDef ∧ W₀ = M ^ (1 / p) ∧
      objective p M W₀ = p * tracePower (1 / p) M ∧
      ∀ W : Matrix d d ℂ, W.PosDef → objective p M W ≤ objective p M W₀ := by
  have hW₀ : (M ^ (1 / p)).PosDef := (hM.isStrictlyPositive.rpow M (1 / p)).posDef
  have heq : objective p M (M ^ (1 / p)) = p * tracePower (1 / p) M := by
    have hprod : M * ((M ^ (1 / p)) ^ (1 - p)) = M ^ (1 / p) := by
      rw [CFC.rpow_rpow M (1 / p) (1 - p) (by positivity) hM.isStrictlyPositive]
      conv_lhs => lhs; rw [← CFC.rpow_one M hM.posSemidef.nonneg]
      rw [← CFC.rpow_add hM.isUnit]
      congr 1
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [objective, hprod, tracePower]
    ring
  exact ⟨_, hW₀, rfl, heq, fun W hW ↦ heq.symm ▸ forward_trace_young hM hW hp hp1⟩

#print axioms forward_trace_young
#print axioms maximum_and_attainment
end D5.S3.Quantum.Hiai.ForwardTraceYoung

namespace D5.S3.Quantum.Hiai.PsiMeanTraceConcavity
open scoped MatrixOrder Matrix.Norms.L2Operator ComplexOrder
open Matrix InverseMeanVariational GeneralizedPerspectiveFunction LiebAndoTrace LownerHeinzTheorem
variable {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
local instance : Pow (Matrix d d ℂ) ℝ := ⟨CFC.rpow⟩

private lemma map_strict {A B : Type*} [CStarAlgebra A] [CStarAlgebra B]
    [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] [PartialOrder B] [StarOrderedRing B]
    (φ : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] B) {X : A} (hX : IsStrictlyPositive X) : IsStrictlyPositive (φ X) := by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩ := CStarAlgebra.isStrictlyPositive_iff_eq_star_mul_self.mp hX
  rw [map_mul, map_star]
  exact CStarAlgebra.isStrictlyPositive_iff_eq_star_mul_self.mpr ⟨φ Q, hQ.map φ, rfl⟩

private lemma map_power {A B : Type*} [CStarAlgebra A] [CStarAlgebra B]
    [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] [PartialOrder B] [StarOrderedRing B]
    (φ : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] B) {X : A} (hX : IsStrictlyPositive X) (s : ℝ) :
    φ (X ^ s) = (φ X) ^ s := by
  rw [CFC.rpow_def, CFC.rpow_def]
  exact StarAlgHomClass.map_cfc φ (fun x : NNReal ↦ x ^ s) X
    (NNReal.continuousOn_rpow_const (.inl (spectrum.zero_notMem NNReal hX.isUnit)))
    (StarAlgEquiv.isometry φ).continuous hX.nonneg (map_strict φ hX).nonneg

/-- The classical base-first geometric mean, with spectral matrix powers. -/
def geometricMean (θ : ℝ) (B A : Matrix d d ℂ) : Matrix d d ℂ :=
  B ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (B ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) * A * B ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ θ * B ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)

lemma mean_strict {A B : Matrix d d ℂ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (θ : ℝ) :
    IsStrictlyPositive (geometricMean θ B A) := by
  have hI := hB.isStrictlyPositive.rpow B (-1 / 2)
  have hS := hB.isStrictlyPositive.rpow B (1 / 2)
  have hm := (hI.isUnit.isStrictlyPositive_iff_conjugate_of_isSelfAdjoint A
    (B ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ)) hI.isSelfAdjoint).2 hA.isStrictlyPositive
  exact (hS.isUnit.isStrictlyPositive_iff_conjugate_of_isSelfAdjoint
    ((B ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) * A * B ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ θ) (B ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ))
    hS.isSelfAdjoint).2 (hm.rpow _ θ)

private abbrev φ : Matrix d d ℂ ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] (EuclideanSpace ℂ d →L[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ d) :=
  Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := d) (𝕜 := ℂ)

private lemma φ_pd {A : Matrix d d ℂ} (hA : A.PosDef) : φ A ∈ pdSet := by
  have h := map_strict φ hA.isStrictlyPositive
  exact ⟨h.isSelfAdjoint, fun _ hx ↦ h.spectrum_pos hx⟩

private lemma φ_mean {A B : Matrix d d ℂ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (θ : ℝ) :
    φ (geometricMean θ B A) = HiaiGeometricMean.mean θ (φ B) (φ A) := by
  have hI := hB.isStrictlyPositive.rpow B (-1 / 2)
  have hm := (hI.isUnit.isStrictlyPositive_iff_conjugate_of_isSelfAdjoint A
    (B ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ)) hI.isSelfAdjoint).2 hA.isStrictlyPositive
  have hsB := map_strict φ hB.isStrictlyPositive
  have his : CFC.sqrt (Ring.inverse (φ B)) = (φ B) ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [CFC.sqrt_eq_rpow, CFC.inverse_eq_rpow_neg_one hsB,
      CFC.rpow_rpow (φ B) (-1) (1 / 2) (by norm_num) hsB]
    norm_num
  unfold geometricMean HiaiGeometricMean.mean
  simp only [CFC.conjSqrt_apply]
  rw [his, CFC.sqrt_eq_rpow, map_mul, map_mul, map_power φ hm,
    map_power φ hB.isStrictlyPositive, map_mul, map_mul, map_power φ hB.isStrictlyPositive]

private lemma mix_pd {A B : Matrix d d ℂ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef)
    {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) : ((1 - t) • A + t • B).PosDef :=
  (CStarAlgebra.convexOn_ringInverse (A := Matrix d d ℂ)).1 hA.isStrictlyPositive
    hB.isStrictlyPositive (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1) ht0 (by ring) |>.posDef

/-- Gamma retains arbitrary Z and one common mixing coefficient for A, B and W. -/
def gamma (p θ : ℝ) (Z A B W : Matrix d d ℂ) : ℝ :=
  (Matrix.trace (Zᴴ * geometricMean θ (B ^ p) (A ^ p) * Z * W ^ (1 - p))).re

private lemma φ_gamma (p θ : ℝ) (Z : Matrix d d ℂ) {A B W : Matrix d d ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (hW : W.PosDef) :
    HiaiHSMeanTrace.gamma p θ (φ Z) (φ A) (φ B) (φ W) = gamma p θ Z A B W := by
  unfold HiaiHSMeanTrace.gamma gamma
  rw [← map_power φ hA.isStrictlyPositive, ← map_power φ hB.isStrictlyPositive,
    ← φ_mean (hA.isStrictlyPositive.rpow A p).posDef (hB.isStrictlyPositive.rpow B p).posDef,
    ← map_power φ hW.isStrictlyPositive, ← map_star φ Z,
    ← map_mul φ, ← map_mul φ, ← map_mul φ]
  change (LinearMap.trace ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ d)
    (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (Zᴴ * geometricMean θ (B ^ p) (A ^ p) * Z * W ^ (1 - p)))).re = _
  rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace ℂ (EuclideanSpace.basisFun d ℂ).toBasis,
    Matrix.toEuclideanLin_eq_toLin_orthonormal, LinearMap.toMatrix_toLin]

/-- Matrix triple concavity, including the empty matrix dimension and arbitrary Z. -/
theorem gamma_triple_concave {p θ t : ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (Z : Matrix d d ℂ)
    {A₀ A₁ B₀ B₁ W₀ W₁ : Matrix d d ℂ}
    (hA₀ : A₀.PosDef) (hA₁ : A₁.PosDef) (hB₀ : B₀.PosDef) (hB₁ : B₁.PosDef)
    (hW₀ : W₀.PosDef) (hW₁ : W₁.PosDef) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    (1 - t) * gamma p θ Z A₀ B₀ W₀ + t * gamma p θ Z A₁ B₁ W₁ ≤
      gamma p θ Z ((1 - t) • A₀ + t • A₁) ((1 - t) • B₀ + t • B₁)
        ((1 - t) • W₀ + t • W₁) := by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty d with
  | inl hd =>
    letI := hd
    simp [gamma, Matrix.trace]
  | inr hd =>
    letI := hd
    have h := HiaiHSMeanTrace.hs_gamma_triple_concave hp hθ (φ Z)
      (φ_pd hA₀) (φ_pd hA₁) (φ_pd hB₀) (φ_pd hB₁) (φ_pd hW₀) (φ_pd hW₁) ht0 ht1
    have hm (X Y : Matrix d d ℂ) :
        (1 - t) • φ X + t • φ Y = φ ((1 - t) • X + t • Y) := by
      simp only [map_add, ← Complex.coe_smul, map_smul]
    rw [hm, hm, hm, φ_gamma p θ Z hA₀ hB₀ hW₀, φ_gamma p θ Z hA₁ hB₁ hW₁,
      φ_gamma p θ Z (mix_pd hA₀ hA₁ ht0 ht1) (mix_pd hB₀ hB₁ ht0 ht1)
        (mix_pd hW₀ hW₁ ht0 ht1)] at h
    exact h

/-- The actual outer spectral trace power; the geometric mean base is B^p. -/
def psi (p θ : ℝ) (Z A B : Matrix d d ℂ) : ℝ :=
  tracePower (1 / p) (Zᴴ * geometricMean θ (B ^ p) (A ^ p) * Z)

private lemma congruence_pd (p θ : ℝ) {A B Z : Matrix d d ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (hZ : IsUnit Z) :
    (Zᴴ * geometricMean θ (B ^ p) (A ^ p) * Z).PosDef := by
  exact ((mean_strict (hA.isStrictlyPositive.rpow A p).posDef
    (hB.isStrictlyPositive.rpow B p).posDef θ).posDef).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
      (Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr hZ)

/-- Exact Psi joint concavity by mixing the attained endpoint optimizers. -/
theorem psi_jointly_concave {p θ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (Z : Matrix d d ℂ) (hZ : IsUnit Z) :
    JointlyConcaveOn {A : Matrix d d ℂ | A.PosDef} {B : Matrix d d ℂ | B.PosDef}
      (psi p θ Z) := by
  intro A₀ A₁ B₀ B₁ t hA₀ hA₁ hB₀ hB₁ ht0 ht1
  let M₀ := Zᴴ * geometricMean θ (B₀ ^ p) (A₀ ^ p) * Z
  let M₁ := Zᴴ * geometricMean θ (B₁ ^ p) (A₁ ^ p) * Z
  obtain ⟨W₀, hW₀, _, heq₀, _⟩ :=
